content: MDN aria-current: aria-current=page marks the current item in a set of related links (breadcrumb/pagination/view links); exactly ONE element in the set carries it; absent/false/empty = not exposed. Do NOT use aria-current in place of aria-selected for tab/option/gridcell/row roles - confirms views-as-links (D14-22) not tablist. Enumerated values: page, step, location, date, time, true, false; unknown non-null strings treated as true.
